none: PAS CAM-E20E38: Roman Coin : Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD317-337
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD317-337. Mint is uncertain, AD330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse shows laureate bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]IVN[...]. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.58g, diameter is 17.87mm
